headline: Kings’ Zuccarello out against Rangers with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Kings forward Mats Zuccarello will miss the game against the Rangers with an upper-body injury. The outlet adds that he has already missed time this season and has contributed minimally when he has played for L.A.

The bigger story is that the Kings are already struggling without much help from the injury list. LAK sit at 2-5-2 with six points from nine games, and our numbers suggest the record is a little worse than the play. Their expected goals share (the share of scoring chances, weighted by quality, that they generate versus allow) is 46.6%, so they are being outchanced overall. They have also scored 3.7 fewer goals than their chances should have produced, and their goaltending has saved 3.6 fewer goals than expected, so finishing and saves are both hurting them so far this season. NYR are the opponent, at 7-5-1 with a 51.9% expected goals share, and their goaltending has been worth 3.6 goals above expected. That's a tough matchup for a Kings team that needs offense.

We have no data on who picks up Zuccarello's minutes, so we won't guess at a line change.
